# Heytap Developer
> Developer platform for building, integrating, and publishing apps and services in the OPPO/Heytap ecosystem.

Heytap Developer provides documentation, platform services, account tools, and integration resources for developers targeting OPPO and related mobile ecosystem capabilities.

## Developer Portal
- [Developer Home](https://open.oppomobile.com/): Main entry point for OPPO and Heytap developer resources and platform services.
- [Documentation Center](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info): Central hub for developer documentation, integration guides, and platform references.
- [Service Marketplace](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service): Overview of available platform capabilities, APIs, and developer services.
- [Developer Console](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc): Access point for development resources and console-linked documentation.
- [Announcements](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/notice): Official notices, policy updates, and platform announcements for developers.

## Account and App Management
- [Developer Registration](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11241): Guide to creating and verifying a developer account.
- [App Publishing Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11242): Instructions for submitting, reviewing, and publishing applications.
- [App Update Process](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11243): Documentation for version updates and release management workflows.
- [Package Naming Rules](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11244): Requirements and conventions for application package identifiers.
- [Signing and Certificates](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11245): Guidance on app signing, certificates, and security requirements.

## SDK and Integration Guides
- [SDK Access](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info): Entry point for SDK-related documentation and integration materials.
- [Push Service Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10196): Integration guide for OPPO push notification capabilities.
- [In-App Payment Guide](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10203): Documentation for integrating payment and purchase capabilities.
- [Account Service Integration](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10204): Guide for integrating account login and identity services.
- [Game Service Access](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=10205): Resources for connecting games with platform services.

## API and Platform Services
- [Push Service](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service/capability?code=101): Platform capability page for push messaging and notification delivery.
- [Payment Service](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service/capability?code=102): Platform capability page for billing and payment integration.
- [Account Service](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service/capability?code=103): Platform capability page for user account and login services.
- [Game Service](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service/capability?code=104): Platform capability page for game-related APIs and ecosystem support.
- [Analytics Service](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service/capability?code=105): Platform capability page for analytics and operational insights.

## Policies and Compliance
- [Developer Agreement](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11246): Terms governing use of the developer platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy Requirements](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11247): Privacy and data handling expectations for published applications.
- [Content Review Standards](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11248): Review criteria and content compliance requirements for submissions.
- [App Review Guidelines](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11249): Operational guidance for passing platform review and approval.
- [Security Compliance](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11250): Security-related rules and compliance expectations for developers.

## Support and Operations
- [Help Center](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/help): Support resources for common developer questions and workflows.
- [Contact Support](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/contact): Official contact channels for developer assistance and issue resolution.
- [Feedback Channel](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/feedback): Submission page for platform feedback and developer suggestions.
- [FAQ](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/faq): Frequently asked questions about accounts, publishing, and integrations.
- [Service Status and Notices](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/notice): Operational notices affecting platform services and developer workflows.

## Distribution and Commercialization
- [App Distribution](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11251): Guidance on distributing apps through OPPO platform channels.
- [Commercial Services](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/service): Overview of monetization and business-facing platform capabilities.
- [Advertising and Promotion](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11252): Resources for app promotion and growth-related platform opportunities.
- [Payment Settlement](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11253): Documentation for settlement, billing cycles, and financial operations.
- [Order and Revenue Management](https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=11254): Guidance on transaction records and revenue-related workflows.
